issue_context.title: Copy and paste styles
issue_context.body: cmd + shift + c, Select and then cmd + shift + v should allow copy and pasting the styles of a shape to another (selection of) shape(s)

review_comments: All caps are usually for constants. Could you rename to lowercase
Since it no longer is serialized, you can drop this check. I would expect that you don’t store incorrect values
What should the behavior be for more than 1 element?

It'd take the first that satisfies the condition `isSelected`.
The approach I took was that we're able to copy styles from a single shape, but when pasting we can do it on multiple shapes.
